hook: Fifteen questions, no second chances. Can you score fifteen out of fifteen? Let us find out.

questions.question: Who was the king of the Greek gods?
questions.question_speech: Question one. Who was the king of the Greek gods? A. Zeus. B. Apollo. C. Hermes. D. Ares.

questions.question: What is the Roman name for Zeus?
questions.question_speech: Question two. What is the Roman name for Zeus? A. Neptune. B. Mars. C. Jupiter. D. Saturn.

questions.question: Which Norse god wielded the hammer Mjolnir?
questions.question_speech: Question three. Which Norse god wielded the hammer Mjolnir? A. Loki. B. Thor. C. Baldur. D. Odin.

questions.question: Which monster from Greek myth had snakes for hair?
questions.question_speech: Question four. Which monster from Greek myth had snakes for hair? A. The Chimera. B. The Hydra. C. The Sphinx. D. Medusa.

questions.question: Who was the Greek god of the sea?
questions.question_speech: Question five. Who was the Greek god of the sea? A. Poseidon. B. Hermes. C. Hades. D. Dionysus.

questions.question: Who was the ancient Egyptian god of the sun?
questions.question_speech: Question six. Who was the ancient Egyptian god of the sun? A. Horus. B. Ra. C. Anubis. D. Osiris.

questions.question: Which city did the Greeks enter inside the Trojan Horse?
questions.question_speech: Question seven. Which city did the Greeks enter inside the Trojan Horse? A. Sparta. B. Corinth. C. Athens. D. Troy.

questions.question: Where did the Minotaur live?
questions.question_speech: Question eight. Where did the Minotaur live? A. In a forest. B. In a volcano. C. In a labyrinth. D. In the sea.
questions.answer_speech: C is correct, In a labyrinth.

questions.question: In Norse myth, what is the hall of slain warriors called?
questions.question_speech: Question nine. In Norse myth, what is the hall of slain warriors called? A. Valhalla. B. Helheim. C. Midgard. D. Asgard.

questions.question: Which winged horse appears in Greek myth?
questions.question_speech: Question ten. Which winged horse appears in Greek myth? A. Bucephalus. B. Unicorn. C. Sleipnir. D. Pegasus.

questions.question: Who was the Greek goddess of wisdom?
questions.question_speech: Question eleven. Who was the Greek goddess of wisdom? A. Hera. B. Athena. C. Aphrodite. D. Artemis.

questions.question: Which Egyptian god had the head of a jackal?
questions.question_speech: Question twelve. Which Egyptian god had the head of a jackal? A. Horus. B. Thoth. C. Anubis. D. Sobek.

questions.question: What is the Greek name of the hero the Romans called Hercules?
questions.question_speech: Question thirteen. What is the Greek name of the hero the Romans called Hercules? A. Odysseus. B. Heracles. C. Perseus. D. Achilles.

questions.question: Who was the Greek god of the underworld?
questions.question_speech: Question fourteen. Who was the Greek god of the underworld? A. Apollo. B. Helios. C. Hades. D. Ares.

questions.question: On which mountain did the Greek gods live?
questions.question_speech: Question fifteen. On which mountain did the Greek gods live? A. Mount Etna. B. Mount Sinai. C. Mount Ida. D. Mount Olympus.
